threat_model.reference: The DXC'26 LiU-ICE grey-box solution uses a 90-second (1800 sample at 20 Hz) initialization and adaptive covariate-shift warm-up.
threat_model.disclosed_failure: The publication states that a fault present from engine startup may be absorbed into the adaptive healthy baseline, creating a temporary temporal blind spot.
adversary_and_fault_cases: slowly developing fault below a point residual threshold
new supported-looking but actually unsupported operating regime
sensor bias or dropout during warm-up
command/response clock or gateway common-cause failure
an unknown fault that does not trigger a known-class alarm
an anomaly that begins during a restart or model reset

core_invariant: The last independently qualified live baseline stays frozen and continues to generate the diagnostic reference while all new adaptation data are collected in a separate shadow candidate. No candidate update can change live inference until an external independent review and separate authorization process accepts it.

live_reference.identity: content-addressed baseline and frozen model digest
live_reference.role: continues inference from sample zero; there is no 90-second detection-off period

shadow_candidate.policy: candidate only; never used as the active detection reference

quarantine_triggers: any required sensor missing, stale, conflicted or uncalibrated
command history absent or causally invalid
standardized residual outside the frozen acceptance envelope
sample gap, timestamp reversal or recording identity change
architecture.completion: After the predeclared shadow sample count, produce a candidate digest plus two or more independently verified health attestations from distinct issuer and dependency domains. This creates a review package, not a baseline update.
architecture.update_authority: An external baseline-governance owner must review the complete candidate, attestations, prior baseline, model, rollback package and scope. The guard has no commit or activation function.

policy.sample_order: contiguous sample indices and strictly increasing timestamps
policy.candidate_review: two distinct upstream verified issuers from separate verified dependency domains; every attestation binds the exact candidate manifest digest

sample_receipt_binds: command history and causal timing decisions
known/unknown fault alarms and ambiguity state
evidence_contract.authenticity_limit: Digest integrity does not authenticate signers. Issuer identity, competence, independence, authority scope, expiry, revocation and evidence-source provenance must be verified upstream.

comparators.method: Continue using the qualified reference baseline; never learn during the evaluation.
Reproduce immediate online baseline updates; deliberately stress-test fault absorption.
Reproduce the published fixed warm-up behavior and startup masking risk.
Accumulate candidate data separately; quarantine on any support, residual, alarm, ambiguity or data-quality violation.
Shadow quarantine plus multiple independent, digest-bound health attestations and separate owner authorization.

required_metrics: p95/p99 inference latency during parallel shadow collection
hard_gates: the previously qualified live baseline remains frozen throughout shadow collection
the live baseline continues to produce predictions from sample zero
a startup fault is never used to initialize or update the live healthy reference
any known or unknown fault alarm or ambiguous hypothesis set quarantines the entire candidate
an unsupported regime, missing/stale sensor or invalid command-response timing quarantines the entire candidate
sample gaps, time reversal and cross-recording samples are rejected
candidate samples are append-only and individually receipt-bound
the proposal is bound to the exact original baseline and model digests
independent health attestations must refer to the exact candidate manifest
attestation issuers and dependency domains are unique and independently verified upstream
the module cannot commit, activate or authorize a new baseline
baseline replacement requires external owner approval, rollback evidence and post-update regression testing
no aggregate readiness score can compensate for a startup fault-masking failure

research_targets_not_achieved.target: Zero startup-fault episodes absorbed into the healthy baseline on the frozen fault-at-startup and fault-during-warmup falsification suite.
Live reference detection remains active from sample zero; no fixed warm-up interval suppresses reporting.
For onset-annotated supported cases, detect or explicitly abstain within 0.50 seconds while preserving the matched false-alarm budget.
Zero live-baseline digest changes during candidate collection, quarantine, or independent review.
Parallel shadow collection adds less than 10% p95 inference latency and causes no queue growth on the pinned 20 Hz reference device.

evidence_boundary.implementation: Rust shadow candidate state machine in src/startup_adaptation.rs; synthetic contract tests only.
evidence_boundary.claim_ceiling: Fail-closed baseline adaptation contract and synthetic tests only; no field startup safety or production deployment claim.
